description: Securely connect ChatGPT to user-authorized computers and servers for file operations, terminal commands, process management, and device diagnostics.

interface.longDescription: MCPENROUZ connects ChatGPT to computers and servers you explicitly authorize. Explore files, read or edit documents, run terminal commands, manage background processes, and inspect device diagnostics through a secured MCP connection. Every connected device has locally configured read and write roots, with separate opt-in permissions for shell access, file deletion, and system process control. Terminal commands run with the connected device account permissions and are not sandboxed by file-tool roots. Only connect devices you own or are authorized to manage. Devices connect over outbound HTTPS and require no inbound port forwarding. For setup, visit https://mcp.penrouz.com/setup.

publication.release_notes: Resubmission of the existing MCPENROUZ plugin after the owner withdrew the previous review. Updated listing copy to clarify user authorization and separate controls for terminal commands, file changes, and destructive operations. Preserved the existing MCP endpoint, OAuth connection, visual assets, reviewer sandbox workflow, five positive and three negative test cases, and the public demonstration URL. Server tool definitions are unchanged by this ZIP.
